parameters.name: EipAddresses
parameters.description: The list of EIP addresses used to filter instances.

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The list of edge zone IDs. This parameter is a formatted JSON array that contains up to 100 IDs separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: EnsServiceId
parameters.description: The Edge Node Service ID. You can use this ID to query the instances created under the edge service.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The list of instance IDs. This parameter is a formatted JSON array that contains up to 100 IDs separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: OrderByParams
parameters.description: The sorting parameter in JSON format.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the instance status list. The value starts from **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: **100**.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The search keyword. Supports parameters such as **ip**, **InstanceName**, and **InstanceId**.

parameters.name: ServiceStatus
parameters.description: The business status of the instance, which does not represent the actual running status of the instance.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The instance status. Valid values:

- Running: Running.
- Stopped: Stopped.
- Expired: Expired.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The resource tags. This operation does not return tag information. Use this parameter in combination with the APIs in the tag category.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
